response: Yes, aberrant loss of dickkopf-3 (DKK3) in gastric cancer has been associated with lymph node metastasis. Studies have shown that decreased expression of DKK3 is correlated with increased risk of lymph node metastasis. Therefore, preoperative assessment of DKK3 expression levels may potentially serve as a predictive biomarker for lymph node metastasis in gastric cancer patients.
